editorial:
Max Chêne is the kind of guy who can talk anyone into anything. As a life coach, he pumps up athletes, politicians, and CEOs with his endless energy and smooth talk. But when his gambling habit spirals out of control and his wife kicks him out, his perfect life starts falling apart fast. That's when a mysterious new client shows up, offering him a job that could either save him or sink him completely. The movie mixes big laughs with real heart, and you'll find yourself rooting for Max even when he makes terrible choices. The tone stays light and breezy, with plenty of awkward moments and quick one-liners that keep things moving.

The cast really sells the comedy, especially the lead performance that balances charm with desperation. The pacing is snappy, though a few side plots feel rushed. Still, the humor lands more often than not, and the emotional beats feel earned. If you enjoy feel-good comedies with a flawed but lovable hero, this one is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Max discovers his mysterious client is actually the person who set up his gambling debts in the first place, hoping to break him down and rebuild him. Instead of walking away, Max uses his coaching skills to turn the tables, helping his client face their own fears. He pays off his debts, reconciles with his wife, and starts a new coaching practice focused on honesty. The twist is that the client was testing Max all along, and passing means Max finally learns to coach himself.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves feel-good comedies with a flawed but lovable hero.
